subject: Augment plan: tier shift and burst-credit discussion
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@omnisketch.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal/Q3 usage review and options

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Attached is our Q3 export that shows the spike after we shipped the new image-tagging feature. High-level:
- Current monthly token spend: ~4.2B tokens (up from 1.1B pre-release)
- P50 inference latency increased by ~30ms on the largest gen models
- We project a further 50% increase if we enable higher-resolution prompts for the next campaign

We have a renewal coming up in late Sep and want to understand options for smoothing unit costs without blocking performance. Specifically: can we discuss flexible burst credits, a short-term tier bump, and whether Redwood can suggest model/quantization combos that preserve throughput?

Attached: Q3_usage_report.pdf, latency-snapshot.csv

Appreciate any quick thoughts and whether we should schedule a call this week.

—Alex Mercer
Head of Product, OmniSketch
alex@omnisketch.com
[Attachment: Q3_usage_report.pdf (PDF, 530KB)]
[Attachment: latency-snapshot.csv (CSV, 48KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@omnisketch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal/Q3 usage review and options

Alex —

Thanks for the export, that spike is visible in our telemetry too. Quick notes:
- We can offer a short-term burst credit (30 days) to cover the immediate uplift while we align commit levels.
- A staged tier shift (one month trial of the next tier) gives predictable unit pricing and reserves burst capacity.
- Marissa will run a cost/ROI estimate and Ben can propose a technical mitigation (quantized variant + batching) to reduce per-token spend without degrading quality.

Would you be open to a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the numbers and a proposed action plan? I’ll include a sample proposed-tier-change.xlsx with the economics.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal/Q3 usage review and options

Alex — Vanessa —

Quick technical/econ sketch before the call:

1) Token & cost profile (baseline & conservative projection)
- Baseline (current month): 4.2B tokens, blended unit cost $0.000012/token => ~$50k/month
- Near-term projection if new feature scales: 6.3–6.8B tokens => $76k–$82k/month at current tier

2) Practical options we recommend
- Short-term: 30-day burst credit of 20% of current monthly spend (covers ~0.84B tokens) to avoid throttle while we finalize commit.
- Mid-term: Tier bump + 20% commit increase (committed tokens/month to be renegotiated) — net modeled savings ~18% vs. paying overage. See proposed-tier-change.xlsx tab "savings-model".
- Tech mitigation: run a 2-week pilot on a quantized 4-bit variant for the large image-caption model + aggressive batching for low-latency routes; we expect 15–22% token-cost reduction with <10ms P50 impact.

3) Operational guardrails (what we need from OmniSketch)
- Production traffic window for the pilot (2 weeks, sample of 10% of traffic)
- A list of top 5 high-cost prompts and expected QPS during campaign
- PO / acceptance of the burst credit (we can handle via a short addendum to renewal)

If you want, I can seed the HubSpot deal with the new commit numbers and a DocuSign envelope for the addendum so procurement can review internally (I’ll attach links).

On the call we can walk through the numbers and the runbook for the pilot.

—Ben Carter
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Thanks all —

This is helpful and aligns with internal thinking. A few items from our side:
- We can commit to a 20% increase for three months if the pilot demonstrates the quantized path maintains fidelity.
- Procurement asked for the DocuSign addendum up front; if you can seed that we’ll route it internally and aim for sign-off before the end of the month.
- Can Ben’s pilot team provide a short test-plan and expected KPIs (latency P50, top-5 prompt accuracy checks)?

Let’s hold the call for Thursday at 10:00 PT so we can have procurement & engineering present.

Best,
